fontSizeFooter: 字号会同时放大正文、标题与列表行，不会改变系统设置；界面已按所选比例排版，无需重启。
The text size scales body copy, titles and list rows together without touching system settings; the layout follows it immediately, no restart needed.
appearancePoem: Hear every sound, tell clear from murky
appearancePoemBody: 网络连通性、规则命中与设备状态，都在这一页里说清楚。
Connectivity, rule matches and device state, all explained on one page.
appearanceHomeOpacitySubtitle: 交互组件与文字的透明度
Opacity of interactive components and text
appearancePureBlackOn: 深色表面折叠为纯黑，OLED 更省电
Dark surfaces collapse to pure black, saving power on OLED
appearancePureBlackOff: 切到深色模式后才可开启
Available once dark mode is on
appearanceHomeSentenceSubtitle: 运行与停止两种状态各一句
One sentence each for running and stopped
appearanceNotificationSubtitle: 常驻通知、实时速率与自定义文案
Persistent notification, live rate and custom text
appearanceHapticSubtitle: 切换 tab 时给一次轻震
A short vibration when switching tabs
appearanceTabTransitionSubtitle: 切换底部标签时的动画方式
appearanceMotionFooter: 底栏样式、动画与玻璃只作用于浮条；普通底栏始终是实色。
Style, animation and glass only apply to the floating bar; the docked bar stays solid.
appearancePaletteGoldLegacy: 落盘值沿用旧版的 indigo
Stored value keeps the legacy indigo
appearancePaletteFooter: 色板只提供种子，上屏的是 HCT 推导出的整套角色色。旧版没有自定义取色，因此这里也不提供。
The palette only supplies a seed; the screen shows the full HCT-derived role set. The legacy app had no custom picker, so there is none here.
fontFamilySystemDefault: 跟随宿主平台的中文界面字体，最稳妥的选择
Follows the host platform's interface font; the safest choice
fontFamilyEmpty: 还没有导入字体。导入后即可在这里切换，字体文件只保存在本机。
No imported fonts yet. Once imported you can switch here; font files stay on this device.
fontFamilyFooter: 导入的字体只影响本机显示，删除后会自动回退到系统默认。
Imported fonts only affect this device and fall back to the system default when deleted.
fontFamilyLocalOnly: 选择只影响本机显示，不改动服务端规则。
The choice only affects this device and never changes server-side rules.
fontFamilyDeleteConfirm: 删除「{name}」后，使用该字体的界面会回退到系统默认。
After deleting "{name}", the interface falls back to the system default font.
fontFamilyPickFile: 选择本机的 TTF / OTF 文件
Pick a TTF / OTF file on this device
notificationPersistentFooter: 关闭后服务运行时不再显示常驻通知，系统可能因此更快回收进程。
When off, no persistent notification is shown while the service runs, so the system may reclaim the process sooner.
notificationPersistentSubtitle: 服务运行时保留一条不可划掉的通知
Keeps an unswipeable notification while the service runs
notificationShowSpeedSubtitle: 在通知里显示当前上下行速率
Shows the current up/down rate in the notification
notificationTextRunning: When the DNS service is on
notificationTextStopped: When the DNS service is off
notificationTextHint: Leave empty to use the default text
notificationTextFooter: 留空则使用默认文案；文案只影响通知栏，不改变服务行为。
Empty fields use the default text; the wording only affects the notification, never the service.
notificationSystemPermissionSubtitle: 打开系统的通知设置页
backgroundFooter: 壁纸只保存在本机，不随备份导出。
Wallpapers stay on this device and are never exported with backups.
backgroundBehindPages: 在全部页面下垫一层壁纸
Puts a wallpaper behind every page
backgroundAddedFooter: Tap to switch, long-press to delete.
backgroundEmptyDescription: 点「添加图片」从相册里挑一张。
Tap "Add image" and pick one from the gallery.
backgroundDeleteConfirm: 确定删除这张已添加的壁纸吗？
foregroundPrivacyFooter: 「后台隐藏」会从最近任务列表里移除本应用；下次从桌面图标进入即可。
Hiding in the background removes the app from the recent tasks list; open it again from the home screen.
foregroundHideSubtitle: 不在最近任务列表中显示
Not shown in the recent tasks list
foregroundBypassLanSubtitle: 本地网段与本机地址不走隧道
Local subnets and this device stay off the tunnel
foregroundBatteryFooter: 关闭电池优化后，系统在后台更不容易回收服务进程。
With battery optimisation off, the system is less likely to reclaim the service process.
foregroundIgnoreBatterySubtitle: 请求把本应用加入系统白名单
Ask to whitelist this app in the system
dayNightFollowSystemDescription: 系统切换深色时一起切换
Switches together with the system dark mode
dayNightFooter: 纯黑只在深色模式下生效，开关在「外观设置」的界面显示组里。
Pure black only applies in dark mode; its switch lives in the Interface group of Appearance.
homeOpacityComponentsFooter: 透明度只影响可见度，不影响这些组件的点击区域。
Opacity only affects visibility, not the tap targets of these components.
bottomBarMinimumHint: Keep at least 2 items in the bottom bar
bottomBarDragHint: 按住右侧把手或长按整行拖动排序，顺序即底栏从左到右的顺序。至少 2 项、最多 {max} 项：浮条按项数等比分配宽度，再多就挤到看不清图标。

Drag by the handle on the right or long-press a row to reorder; the order is the bottom bar order from left to right. Keep 2 to {max} items: the floating bar splits its width evenly and more would squeeze the icons.
bottomBarNewItemFooter: 新启用的项排在底栏最右侧。
Newly enabled items go to the far right.
homeSentenceFooter: 两项均可留空；留空后对应状态下首页不显示句子，句子只在首页电源区下方出现一次。
Both fields may stay empty; when empty, no sentence is shown in that state. The sentence appears once, below the power button.
